environment.description: Terraform provider connecting through PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode (pool_mode=transaction) with server-side prepared statement handling disabled (max_prepared_statements=0, disable_pqexec=1). PgBouncer configuration includes custom query filter via auth_query rewrite that enforces parameterized execution: any query containing unescaped single-quote literals outside of $-quoted strings is rejected at the pooler level with 'disallowed query pattern' error (implemented via pgbouncer's server_check_query hook combined with a custom pam_exec module that validates query AST before forwarding). Connection string: DATABASE_URL=postgres://provider:pass@pgbouncer.internal:6432/tfstate?prepared_statements=off&statement_cache_mode=describe

config.query_filter: disable_pqexec=1, custom auth_query rewrite with AST-level single-quote literal rejection in non-$-quoted contexts
config.network: internal VPC, port 8080 exposed to CI/CD subnet
config.state_storage: S3 with scoped IAM write access
config.pgbouncer_extra: server_check_query combined with pam_exec module for query validation, statement_cache_mode=describe on client DSN
